name: Muhammad Ehtisham Khan
headline: AI Engineer building practical AI systems, multi-agent workflows, and computer vision applications.
status: Currently working as an AI Engineer at Irvinei · Karachi, Pakistan

paragraphs: I'm a Computer Science graduate from Sir Syed University of Engineering & Technology (SSUET) in Karachi, currently working full-time as an AI Engineer at Irvinei.

Most of my day-to-day work sits at the intersection of applied machine learning and backend software engineering. At Irvinei, I architected a 15-stage autonomous model training pipeline using LangGraph, FastAPI, and MongoDB, and previously contributed to the computer vision stack for a commercial consumer security device shipped to customers.

I enjoy taking messy, manual technical workflows—like finding datasets, cleaning corrupt annotations, estimating GPU memory, tuning YOLO models, or querying scattered logs—and turning them into reliable, self-recovering software systems with clean APIs.
Right now, I'm focused on multi-agent orchestration with deterministic guardrails, hybrid vector + structured snapshot retrieval (RAG), and low-latency model deployment using ONNX and TensorRT.

bullets: Architected a 15-stage autonomous model training pipeline (LangGraph, FastAPI, MongoDB) that takes a plain-language request—such as training a PPE detector under a 1-hour, 16GB VRAM budget—and runs dataset discovery, validation, training, evaluation, and hardware export end-to-end.

Built native Python agent tools for multi-source dataset search (Roboflow, Kaggle, Hugging Face, GitHub), GPU VRAM estimation, dynamic YOLOv8/YOLO11 config generation, and automated metric evaluation.

Engineered a hybrid RAG supervision and diagnostic chat system using OpenAI and Anthropic models, pairing Qdrant vector search with exact JSON telemetry snapshots from Redis and MongoDB to prevent fabricated metrics.

Added self-healing training recovery (automatically catching CUDA out-of-memory errors and worker crashes by adjusting batch sizes and resuming checkpoints) and multi-format export pipelines (ONNX, TensorRT, CoreML, TFLite, OpenVINO).
Contributed to a commercial consumer AI security device shipped to customers, implementing real-time on-device computer vision alerts with zero cloud video storage to preserve user privacy.
Co-developed LangGraph multi-agent workflows and real-time inference pipelines for the platform's core CV Engine across cameras, drones, and edge devices.
Processed and validated 1,000+ daily image and video samples through automated annotation and data-cleaning pipelines while maintaining 95%+ dataset accuracy.
Worked with a distributed engineering team to establish dataset validation rules, evaluation benchmarks, and technical documentation.

featured_projects.title: Agentic ML — Autonomous Computer Vision Training Platform
featured_projects.short_description: Autonomous 15-stage multi-agent platform that discovers datasets, validates annotations, trains YOLOv8/11 models, recovers from GPU failures, and exports deployment weights from a single natural-language request.
featured_projects.problem: Training custom computer vision models required hours of manual work: searching multiple platforms for datasets, fixing broken annotation files, guessing batch sizes that wouldn't crash GPU VRAM, and manually tuning hyperparameters when accuracy stalled.
featured_projects.solution: Built a stateful 15-stage LangGraph multi-agent pipeline exposed via FastAPI that automates the entire lifecycle from prompt parsing and dataset curation to GPU pre-flight checks, self-healing training, and closed-loop retraining.
architecture: Goal Parser & Planner Node: Extracts target classes, latency targets, and VRAM/time budgets from user prompts.

Dataset Discovery & Quality Gate: Queries Roboflow, Kaggle, Hugging Face, and GitHub; validates class distributions; auto-repairs corrupt images/labels; uploads clean splits to AWS S3 & Cloudflare R2.
Pre-Flight GPU Dry Run: Estimates peak VRAM usage and runs a 1-epoch dry run before queuing full training.
Self-Healing Training Worker: Streams live loss telemetry; automatically catches CUDA Out-Of-Memory errors, scales down batch size, and resumes from the last checkpoint.
Closed-Loop Evaluator & Exporter: Evaluates mAP, Precision, Recall, and F1 against thresholds and exports passing models to ONNX, TensorRT, CoreML, TFLite, and OpenVINO.
featured_projects.contribution: Designed the 15-stage LangGraph state machine, wrote the native Python agent tools (dataset search, VRAM estimator, config generator, OOM recovery loop), and built the FastAPI control endpoints.
featured_projects.results: Reduced end-to-end custom model creation from days of manual ML engineering to a single automated run with automatic recovery from GPU memory crashes.

featured_projects.title: Hybrid RAG Supervision & Diagnostic Engine
featured_projects.short_description: Dual-path Retrieval-Augmented Generation system combining Qdrant semantic vector search with exact JSON state snapshots from Redis and MongoDB, backed by anti-hallucination verification.
featured_projects.problem: Standard vector-only RAG systems struggle with live operational telemetry—when engineers asked about a specific training run's loss spike or hyperparameter config, pure embedding search often retrieved stale or approximate chunks and hallucinated numbers.
featured_projects.solution: Architected a hybrid retrieval pipeline that pairs dense semantic search in Qdrant with deterministic key-value snapshot lookup in Redis and MongoDB, followed by a verification step that checks numeric claims before returning the response.
architecture: Query Router: Classifies incoming engineering questions into conceptual queries, live telemetry lookups, or hybrid diagnostics.
Parallel Retrieval Layer: Fetches top-k semantic embeddings from Qdrant while pulling exact JSON run snapshots from Redis cache and MongoDB.
Context Assembly & LLM Dispatch: Formats structured telemetry alongside documentation chunks for OpenAI and Anthropic Claude models.
Anti-Hallucination Verification Gate: Cross-checks generated metrics (loss, mAP, epoch counts) against the ground-truth JSON snapshot prior to streaming.
featured_projects.contribution: Built the hybrid Qdrant + Redis/MongoDB retrieval layer, prompt augmentation templates, and the post-generation numeric verification filter.
featured_projects.results: Eliminated fabricated metric reporting in diagnostic chat while keeping end-to-end retrieval latency under 180ms.

featured_projects.title: Network Security Phishing Detection & MLOps ETL Pipeline
featured_projects.short_description: End-to-end cybersecurity classification and data engineering system featuring automated Python ETL into MongoDB, schema validation gates, modular training stages, Docker containerization, and GitHub Actions CI/CD.
featured_projects.problem: Security datasets frequently suffer from schema drift and missing values, and models trained in isolated notebooks fail to deploy reproducibly into production APIs.
featured_projects.solution: Engineered a modular Python package with an automated ETL loader (`push_data.py`), YAML schema validation gates, multi-model benchmarking, and a Dockerized FastAPI service deployed via GitHub Actions.
architecture: ETL Extraction & Loading (`push_data.py`): Reads raw phishing and network datasets, normalizes records, and bulk-loads JSON documents into MongoDB.
Data Validation Gate (`data_schema`): Validates incoming feature columns, data types, and drift thresholds before training.
Model Training & Tracking: Benchmarks ensemble classifiers with automated artifact versioning.
CI/CD & Container Deployment: Packages the inference API inside a Docker image built and tested automatically via GitHub Actions workflows.
featured_projects.contribution: Built the entire repository architecture—including the MongoDB ETL scripts, schema validator, training pipeline, Dockerfile, and GitHub Actions CI/CD workflow.
featured_projects.results: Delivered a reproducible, containerized ML microservice with automated data validation and zero-downtime CI/CD builds.

featured_projects.title: SenseBridge — Multimodal AI Accessibility Platform
featured_projects.short_description: Unified accessibility web application chaining speech-to-text (90+ languages), text-to-speech, image captioning + OCR, and text-to-image synthesis into a single modular Python platform.
featured_projects.problem: Visually and hearing-impaired users often have to switch between separate, fragmented tools for transcription, screen reading, document OCR, and visual description.
featured_projects.solution: Created a single web interface that chains four distinct AI modalities—OpenAI Whisper, Salesforce BLIP, Tesseract OCR, and gTTS—backed by a local SQLite history database.
architecture: Audio Transcription Pipeline: Processes microphone or uploaded audio through OpenAI Whisper across 90+ languages.
Dual Visual Understanding Engine: Combines Salesforce BLIP scene captioning with Tesseract OCR to read both natural photos and document text.
Speech & Visual Synthesis: Converts text to natural audio via gTTS and generates illustrative visuals via Pollinations AI.
Local Persistence Layer: Stores per-modality session logs in SQLite (`database.py`) for offline auditability and privacy.
featured_projects.contribution: Architected the modular Python codebase (`app.py`, `database.py`, `modules/`), integrated all four AI models, and designed the SQLite persistence schema.
featured_projects.results: Successfully defended as the Final Year BSCS Project at SSUET, supporting 90+ languages in a unified accessibility workflow.

featured_projects.title: Transformer Architecture Built From Scratch in PyTorch
featured_projects.short_description: Clean, ground-up PyTorch implementation of the Transformer neural network including multi-head self-attention, positional encoding, custom dataset streaming, autoregressive generation, and unit tests.
featured_projects.problem: Relying solely on high-level library wrappers obscures how attention masks, tensor projections, layer normalization, and autoregressive decoding behave under the hood.
featured_projects.solution: Implemented the complete Transformer architecture from first principles in PyTorch (`model.py`, `train.py`, `generate.py`, `dataset.py`, `config.py`) along with an automated test suite (`test_transformer.py`).
architecture: Core Attention & Blocks (`model.py`): Scaled dot-product attention, multi-head projections, sinusoidal/learned positional encodings, residual connections, and feed-forward blocks.
Data & Config Pipeline (`dataset.py`, `config.py`): Tokenization, sliding context windows, and centralized hyperparameter management.
Training & Generation (`train.py`, `generate.py`): Cross-entropy optimization loop, learning-rate scheduling, and temperature/top-k autoregressive sampling.
Verification Suite (`test_transformer.py`): Unit tests validating causal masking, attention output shapes, and gradient flow.
featured_projects.contribution: Wrote every module and unit test from scratch in PyTorch without relying on pre-built `nn.Transformer` wrappers.
featured_projects.results: Provides a clean, tested reference codebase for custom attention mechanisms and sequence modeling experiments.

other_projects.title: Spatial Memory — Vision LLM & Temporal Event Assistant
other_projects.summary: Camera assistant combining YOLOv8 object detection, multi-object tracking, and a SQLite temporal index so a Vision LLM can answer natural-language questions about what happened and where.

other_projects.title: Student Performance Predictive Pipeline on AWS Elastic Beanstalk
other_projects.summary: End-to-end regression and ensemble pipeline (CatBoost, XGBoost, Scikit-learn) packaged with automated feature transformers and deployed on AWS Elastic Beanstalk.

other_projects.title: YOLO-World & YOLOE-26 Zero-Shot Object Detection
other_projects.summary: Open-vocabulary object detection implementations allowing real-time detection of custom text-prompted classes without model retraining.

other_projects.title: Live Alerts — Motion-Gated Event Routing Pipeline
other_projects.summary: Continuous edge-to-cloud pipeline where motion-gated frame filtering triggers secondary classifiers, webhook notifications, and AWS S3 media archival.
